name: go
description: Go programming language compiler and toolchain for building efficient applications

go.description: Go programming language compiler and build tool with modules support
go.usage:
go mod init myproject # Initialize new Go module
go build -o myapp.exe . # Build executable from current directory
go run main.go # Compile and run Go program directly
go get -u github.com/user/package # Download and update package
go test ./... -v # Run all tests with verbose output
go fmt ./... # Format all Go files in project

gofmt.description: Go source code formatter with automatic code style enforcement
gofmt.usage:
gofmt -w *.go # Format and write back Go files
gofmt -d . # Show formatting differences without writing
gofmt -s -w . # Simplify code while formatting
